verdict.rationale: This story belongs to equity-management and cap-table platforms, which hold an employee's grants and explain their tax treatment, exercise windows and dilution. Claude is a general-purpose AI assistant and developer platform, not an equity platform. Nothing in the evidence shows Claude shipping a first-party equity-explanation feature tied to an employee's own holdings, so the axis is a category mismatch rather than a missing capability.

support.subject: As an employee, the platform explains my equity in plain language — tax treatment, exercise windows, dilution — not just numbers
